verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy axis for a payments platform that holds consumer card and identity data, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion API, or data-erasure controls. Purchase-intent cancellation and token 'life cycle management' are adjacent features (revoking a mandate, managing a credential), not control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
